zh.summary: 以C4 Context確定正在設計的系統、使用角色及外部依賴，為每條關係標明資料與目的。
objectives: 以單一系統為範圍辨識人與直接外部系統。
用有標籤、方向的關係說明輸入與產出。
分開系統範圍、網路位置及安全信任邊界。

readingGuide.goal: 以單一系統為範圍辨識人與直接外部系統。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md與本課合成案例；用紙筆或文字編輯器即可。
readingGuide.route: 先從餐廳辨識外部關係，再讀四層與銀行圖，畫收件系統，最後留下 architecture.md 並自查。
readingGuide.output: 一張Context草圖及相同內容的architecture.md節點／關係紀錄。

sections.heading: 先理解系統、使用者與外界的關係
paragraphs: 這一課最重要的觀念：在設計軟體之前，先搞清楚「我們要建造的是什麼系統、誰會使用它、它需要和哪些外部系統合作」。
這就是 C4 System Context Diagram（系統情境圖）的用途。
它不是用來畫程式碼、API 端點或資料庫結構，而是讓工程師、主管、客戶與其他利害關係人，先對整個系統的範圍形成共同理解。
這堂課可以用一句話記住：
先畫系統和外界的關係，再深入系統內部的技術設計。

sections.heading: 一、用白話理解：把軟體當成一家餐廳
paragraphs: 想像你要開一家餐廳。
你找來設計師、廚師、會計師與工程師，準備規劃餐廳的營運。
在討論廚房設備、瓦斯管線、收銀機怎麼接線之前，大家應該先知道：

- 餐廳服務哪些人？
- 顧客如何訂餐？
- 餐廳是否需要外送平台？
- 是否需要向外部支付業者收款？
- 哪些工作是餐廳自己負責，哪些交給外部公司？
假設我們正在設計一套「餐廳訂餐系統」。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜餐廳訂餐系統與外界
blocks.description: 假設金流與外送均已實際串接。箭頭標明互動方向、資料與目的，不表示執行時序；回覆以獨立方向列出。

nodes.title: 顧客
nodes.body: 選餐點、送出訂單。

nodes.title: 餐廳訂餐系統
nodes.body: 接收訂單、管理訂餐狀態。

nodes.title: 金流系統
nodes.body: 處理付款並回傳交易結果。

nodes.title: 外送平台
nodes.body: 安排配送並提供配送狀態。

paragraphs: 這張圖的重點不在精美，而在於我們能立刻辨認三件事：系統主角、外部參與者、互動關係。
而且，如果餐廳根本沒有外送服務，就不應該因為別人的系統都有外送平台，而把外送服務硬畫進來。
這正是本課教材特別強調的原則：架構圖應描述有證據的實際系統，而不是憑想像補齊功能。

sections.heading: 二、C4 是什麼？為什麼分成四個層級？
paragraphs: C4 是一套描述軟體架構的方法，由 Simon Brown 推廣。你可以把它想成 Google Maps：先看整座城市，再逐步放大到街區、建築物與室內配置。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜C4 的四個放大層級
blocks.description: 四層是由外而內的靜態結構視角，不是四個執行步驟；依溝通需要選用。

items.title: C2 · Container
items.body: 系統由哪些應用與資料儲存組成

items.title: C3 · Component
items.body: 應用程式內有哪些功能元件

items.title: C4 · Code
items.body: 類別、介面等程式碼結構

paragraphs: 由外向內逐層放大。C4 並不要求所有專案都畫滿四層，許多團隊用 Context 和 Container 就足以溝通主要架構。
例如，設計醫院掛號平台：

blocks.caption: 表｜二、C4 是什麼？為什麼分成四個層級？
rows: 病患、醫師、醫院既有系統怎麼與掛號平台互動？
平台內有哪些 Web App、Backend、Database？
Backend 裡有哪些預約、排程、通知模組？
預約服務有哪些類別、介面及程式實作？

paragraphs: 本堂課只需要把 C1：Context 學好。
這裡特別注意，C4 的 Container 是一個架構概念，指應用程式、資料儲存等可執行或儲存單位，不等於 Docker Container。

sections.heading: 三、看一張真正的 C4 System Context Diagram
paragraphs: 先找主系統，再沿每條有標籤的關係閱讀。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜網路銀行的 System Context
blocks.description: 依 Simon Brown／c4model.com 附件改編，CC BY 4.0。箭頭表示使用或合作關係，不是時序；保留四個節點與四條方向關係。

nodes.title: Personal Banking Customer
nodes.body: 持有一個或多個個人銀行帳戶的顧客。

nodes.title: Internet Banking System
nodes.body: 讓顧客透過網頁查看帳戶資訊與付款。

nodes.title: Amazon Web Services Simple Email Service
nodes.body: 雲端電子郵件服務。

nodes.title: Core Banking System
nodes.body: 管理顧客資訊、銀行帳戶及交易等核心功能。

relations.label: 使用郵件服務寄信給顧客
取得帳戶資訊並透過核心系統付款

paragraphs: 依附件 Simon Brown 的虛構網路銀行範例改編。來源：https://c4model.com/diagrams/system-context 。署名：Simon Brown、c4model.com，CC BY 4.0；本圖調整版面與標籤供響應式教學。附件的電子郵件服務為 Amazon Web Services Simple Email Service；這是虛構案例，並非實際銀行的架構聲明。郵件服務 → 顧客的寄信關係也保留，兩端均位於主系統之外。
閱讀這張圖時，先找中央的 Internet Banking System。接著確認誰使用它、它依賴哪些其他系統，以及每條線究竟代表什麼。
例如：
「網路銀行系統 → 核心銀行系統」不是泛泛地表示兩個系統有連接，而是要說明它向核心銀行系統取得帳戶資訊或進行相關銀行操作。
好的 Context 圖，應該讓不懂程式的人也能說出系統如何與外界合作。

sections.heading: 四、實際操作：從零開始畫一張 Context 圖
paragraphs: 現在回到原教材的案例：設計一套「收件完整性檢核系統」。
這套程式的工作很單純。使用者輸入一筆合成資料，程式檢查必要欄位有沒有填寫，最後產生檢查報告。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜收件檢核系統的 Context 示意
blocks.description: 箭頭分別表示輸入要求與結果回饋；虛線範圍框只表示本次描述的系統，不代表安全隔離。沒有外部運行時系統。

nodes.title: 收件人員
nodes.body: 輸入合成資料、查看結果、取得報告。

nodes.title: 收件完整性檢核系統
nodes.body: 檢查欄位、提示缺漏、匯出報告。

relations.label: 輸入合成資料，要求檢查或匯出。
缺漏回饋與完整性報告

paragraphs: 此案例沒有其他直接互動的外部運行時軟體系統，因此不額外增加外部服務。
我們可以按照下面五個步驟建立這張圖。

blocks.caption: 表｜四、實際操作：從零開始畫一張 Context 圖
rows: 運行時依賴哪些其他系統？
誰給誰什麼資料、為了什麼目的？
輸入資料、回傳檢查結果
有沒有把內部技術細節或未實作功能畫進來？
不畫 Python 函式或不存在的 API

blocks.heading: 為什麼要把箭頭的意思寫清楚？
paragraphs: 比較這兩種寫法：

blocks.caption: 表｜四、實際操作：從零開始畫一張 Context 圖：關係標籤
rows: 使用者 → 系統：輸入資料並要求檢查
系統 → 使用者：回傳缺漏資訊及完整性報告
系統 → 外部服務：連接
系統 → 金流服務：送出付款請求並接收交易結果

paragraphs: 箭頭的方向表示互動或依賴的方向，不一定代表一個完整的時序。Context 是描述結構關係的圖，不是記錄每一步先後順序的流程圖。

sections.heading: 五、三個不同產業的應用
paragraphs: 下面是假設性案例，目的是練習辨識主系統和外部關係。

blocks.caption: 表｜五、三個不同產業的應用
rows: 校務身分驗證系統、成績管理系統
AI 影像輔助判讀平台
PACS 影像儲存傳輸系統、外部推論服務（如有使用）
地圖服務、承運商追蹤系統

paragraphs: 以醫療案例來說，PACS（Picture Archiving and Communication System）是管理醫療影像的系統。
如果影像判讀平台需要向既有 PACS 取回 CT 影像，那麼就應該畫出：
PACS → AI 影像判讀平台：提供指定病患的 CT 影像。
但如果整套 AI 都在本機運行，而且根本沒有連接任何外部推論服務，就不應該畫出「雲端 LLM API」。
這正是架構設計最容易犯的錯誤之一：把技術選項、未來計畫和目前已經存在的架構混成一張圖。

sections.heading: 六、AI Coding Agent 究竟要不要畫進去？
paragraphs: 假設你用 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 協助編寫收件檢核系統，但使用者真正操作產品時，程式完全沒有呼叫任何 AI 模型。
那麼 Coding Agent 是開發工具（Development-time Tool），不是產品運行時的依賴。
反過來，假設你設計一套客服平台，顧客每次詢問時，平台都會將訊息傳給外部 LLM API 產生回答。
那麼這個模型服務就成為運行時依賴（Runtime Dependency），應納入 Context。

blocks.caption: 表｜六、AI Coding Agent 究竟要不要畫進去？
rows: AI 幫你產生程式碼，完成後離開
AI Agent 在開發時執行測試
客服產品每次回答都呼叫外部 LLM API
系統在本機執行內嵌的模型
通常描述為主系統內部實作，之後在更細的架構層展開
產品需要連接獨立的外部 AI 推論服務

paragraphs: 另外，不在產品運行時 Context 裡面，不代表開發工具沒有安全風險。Coding Agent 可能讀取原始碼、執行指令或連接網路，仍然需要在開發環境的安全設計中管理權限。

sections.heading: 七、三個容易混淆的重要觀念
paragraphs: 檢查圖中範圍時，逐一分辨下面三組觀念。

blocks.heading: 1. System Context 不等於 User Flow
paragraphs: User Flow 問的是：「使用者先按什麼，再按什麼，接下來發生什麼事？」
System Context 問的是：「這個系統和哪些人、哪些外部系統有關係？」
例如線上購物的「選商品 → 放入購物車 → 結帳」是 User Flow，而「購物系統 ↔ 金流服務」是 System Context 裡的關係。

blocks.heading: 2. 系統邊界不等於安全邊界
paragraphs: 假設 Context 圖中畫了一個框，把「醫療影像分析平台」包起來。
這個框表示你目前討論的軟體範圍，不代表它已經有防火牆、TLS 加密、網路隔離或存取控制。
安全上的 Trust Boundary（信任邊界）需要另外分析：資料從哪個信任區域進入哪個區域，是否需要驗證、授權、加密及監控。

blocks.heading: 3. 外部系統不一定是外部公司的系統
paragraphs: 「外部」是相對於你選定的主系統而言。
例如公司內部的人事系統與薪資系統都由同一家公司維護，但當你的主角是「請假管理系統」，薪資系統仍可能是它的外部依賴。
所以判定的關鍵是系統責任及設計範圍，而不是機器放在哪裡或由哪家公司擁有。

sections.heading: 八、你可以實際完成的成果：architecture.md
paragraphs: 本課教材要求留下一份能讓別人閱讀的系統範圍與關係紀錄。以下是可以直接參考的最小版本。

blocks.heading: architecture.md 最小範本
paragraphs: 將範本存為 architecture.md，依實際範圍修改；此處只使用合成資料。
blocks.code:
# System Context — 收件完整性檢核系統

## 1. 系統目的
提供合成資料的必要欄位檢查、缺漏提示及當次報告匯出。

## 2. 系統範圍
主系統：收件完整性檢核系統

## 3. 使用者
收件人員：輸入資料、檢查結果、取得報告。

## 4. 外部運行時系統
無。

## 5. 互動關係
- 收件人員 → 主系統：
  提供合成資料，要求檢查及匯出。
- 主系統 → 收件人員：
  回饋缺漏資訊，提供檢核報告。

## 6. 不在本次範圍內
- Coding Agent（僅用於開發）
- 正式業務受理
- 尚未實作的外部 API

## 7. 邊界備註
- 系統範圍不等於安全信任邊界。
- 尚未確認的整合應另外列為待確認事項。

paragraphs: 完成後，用以下標準驗收：讓另一位沒有參與開發的人，只閱讀圖與文件，就能正確說出系統的功能、使用者、外部依賴與每條關係的用途，而且不會把尚未實作的功能誤認成已存在。

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核：用一個情境測試自己
paragraphs: 假設你要開發一套「AI 合約審查系統」。律師上傳合約，系統向外部 LLM API 提交必要內容，取得分析後再向律師顯示結果。開發過程則使用 Codex 協助修改程式。
請先回答下方「理解檢核」的三題，再展開參考解析。閱讀解析不會提交答案，也不代表已理解。
本課的核心成果不是畫出一張複雜架構圖，而是具備一種能力：任何新系統開始設計時，都能先清楚界定它的責任、使用者、外部依賴與資料交換關係。 這會成為後續設計 Container、API、授權與安全邊界的重要基礎。

exercise.environment: architecture.md與本課合成案例；用紙筆或文字編輯器即可。
steps: 先畫一個主系統與收件角色，不放Python函式或介面步驟。
為輸入與回饋各畫一條有方向、資料與目的的關係，列出外部依賴的實際依據。
請同儕或自行逐條閱讀，核對沒有把開發Agent當運行時服務，將目前與候選範圍分開。
exercise.expected: 一張Context草圖及相同內容的architecture.md節點／關係紀錄。
exercise.check: 讀者能指出主角、角色與每條關係用途；沒有虛構外部服務，外框不被解讀為安全證據。
exercise.cleanup: 只保留合成名稱與公開可用依據，不貼真實內部系統名稱或架構。

openChecks.prompt:
在 AI 合約審查案例中，哪些元素應該畫在運行時 Context 圖上？
律師、審查系統、LLM API、Codex，全部都要
律師、審查系統、外部 LLM API
只畫 Python 程式與資料庫
answer: 第二項。律師是使用者，審查系統是主系統，外部 LLM API 是運行時依賴。Codex 僅用於開發，另記錄其開發權限。Python 與資料庫內部細節留給更細層級。

openChecks.prompt:
「審查系統 → LLM API」的箭頭，怎麼標示最好？
連接
HTTP
傳送待分析的合約內容，要求產生審查建議
answer: 第三項。它同時說明資料與目的；「連接」沒有交代用途，HTTP 是通訊技術，不能代替業務關係的說明。

openChecks.prompt: 當你發現合約包含機密資訊時，Context 圖已經畫出資料傳送關係，這代表資料安全問題已經解決了嗎？請說明理由。
answer: 尚未。圖只能指出資料會送到外部模型服務；仍須另行確認資料是否允許外送、必要內容與去識別化、服務保留政策，以及驗證、授權、加密與監控。畫出系統範圍與資料關係不等於已實作或驗證安全控制。

en.summary: Use C4 Context to identify the system, user roles and external dependencies, labeling each relationship with data and purpose.
objectives: Identify people and direct external systems around one system.
Explain inputs and outputs with labeled, directed relationships.
Distinguish system scope, network location and security trust boundaries.

readingGuide.goal: Identify people and direct external systems around one system.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and the synthetic case; paper or a text editor is sufficient.
readingGuide.route: Identify restaurant relationships, read the C4 levels and banking example, draw the intake system, then record architecture.md and review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A Context sketch and matching architecture.md node/relationship record.

sections.heading: Establish the system, its users and its external relationships
paragraphs: Before designing software, establish what system you are building, who will use it, and which external systems it needs to cooperate with.
That is the purpose of a C4 System Context diagram.
It gives engineers, managers, customers and other stakeholders a shared understanding of scope before discussing code, API endpoints or database structures.
Remember the lesson in one sentence:
Start with the system’s external relationships, then examine its internal technical design.

sections.heading: 1. An everyday analogy: treat the software as a restaurant
paragraphs: Imagine opening a restaurant.
You bring together a designer, chef, accountant and engineer to plan its operation.
Before discussing kitchen equipment, gas pipes or till wiring, everyone needs to establish:

- Whom does the restaurant serve?
- How do customers order?
- Does the restaurant need a delivery platform?
- Does it collect payment through an external payment provider?
- Which responsibilities belong to the restaurant, and which belong to other companies?
Suppose you are designing a restaurant ordering system.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Restaurant ordering system and its surroundings
blocks.description: Assume payment and delivery integrations exist. Arrows name direction, data and purpose, not a timeline; responses have separate directions.

nodes.title: Customer
nodes.body: Chooses meals and submits orders.

nodes.title: Restaurant ordering system
nodes.body: Receives orders and manages their status.

nodes.title: Payment system
nodes.body: Processes payments and returns transaction results.

nodes.title: Delivery platform
nodes.body: Arranges deliveries and provides status.

relations.label: Chooses meals and submits an order

paragraphs: The diagram lets readers identify the focal system, external participants and their relationships.
If the restaurant offers no delivery service, do not add a delivery platform merely because other restaurants have one.
An architecture diagram should describe a system supported by evidence. Keep candidate features separate from the current system.

sections.heading: 2. What is C4, and why are there four levels?
paragraphs: C4 is an approach to describing software architecture promoted by Simon Brown. Think of zooming into a map: from a city to a neighbourhood, a building and its internal layout. The levels change the detail and the question being answered.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Four C4 levels of detail
blocks.description: Four inward levels of static structure, not four execution steps. Select the views that help communication.

items.title: C1 · Context
items.body: The system and its external relationships

items.title: C2 · Container
items.body: Applications and data stores within the system

items.title: C4 · Code
items.body: Classes, interfaces and other code structures

paragraphs: The view zooms inward. C4 does not require every project to draw every level; Context and Container diagrams communicate the main architecture for many teams.
For a hospital appointment platform, the questions might be:

blocks.caption: Table | 2. What is C4, and why are there four levels?
rows: How do patients, doctors and existing hospital systems interact with the appointment platform?
Which web applications, backends and databases make up the platform?
Which booking, scheduling and notification components are inside the backend?
Which classes, interfaces and implementations make up the booking service?

paragraphs: This lesson focuses on C1: Context.
In C4, a container is an application or data store that runs or stores data. It does not necessarily mean a Docker container.

sections.heading: 3. Read a C4 System Context diagram
paragraphs: Locate the focal system, then follow each labelled relationship.

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Internet banking System Context

nodes.body: A bank customer with one or more personal accounts.

nodes.title: Amazon Web Services Simple Email Service
nodes.body: Cloud-based email service provider.

relations.label: Views account balances and makes payments using
Gets bank account information from and makes payments using

paragraphs: This is an adaptation of Simon Brown’s fictional Internet Banking System example supplied with the lesson. Source: https://c4model.com/diagrams/system-context. Attribution: Simon Brown, c4model.com, CC BY 4.0; the layout and labels have been adapted for responsive teaching. The email service also sends email to the customer. Keep that relationship visible even though both endpoints are outside the focal system. The supplied image names Amazon Web Services Simple Email Service; this is a fictional architecture example, not a claim about an actual bank.
Start by locating the Internet Banking System. Then identify who uses it, which other systems it relies on, and what each directed relationship means.
For example:

“Internet Banking System → Core Banking System” should say that the banking application obtains account information and makes payments through the core system. A generic “connected” label leaves the purpose unclear.
A useful Context diagram lets a reader without programming knowledge explain how the system cooperates with the outside world.

sections.heading: 4. Build a Context diagram from scratch
paragraphs: Return to the course’s intake completeness-checking system.
A user enters a synthetic record; the program checks required fields and produces a report.

blocks.caption: Figure 4 | Intake checking System Context
blocks.description: Arrows distinguish input requests from returned results. The dashed scope boundary identifies the system being described, not security isolation. There are no external runtime systems.

nodes.title: Intake worker
nodes.body: Enters synthetic data, reviews results and obtains reports.

nodes.title: Intake completeness-checking system
nodes.body: Checks fields, identifies omissions and exports reports.

relations.label: Enters synthetic data and requests checking or export.
Returns omission feedback and a completeness report

paragraphs: This case has no other directly interacting external runtime software system, so no external service is added.
Build the diagram in these five steps.

blocks.caption: Table | 4. Build a Context diagram from scratch
rows: Which other systems does it depend on at runtime?
Who supplies what to whom, and for what purpose?
Input data and returned checking results
Have internal details or unimplemented features slipped in?
Exclude Python functions and nonexistent APIs

blocks.heading: Why label arrows clearly?
paragraphs: Compare the two ways of labelling the same relationship:

rows: User → system: supplies data and requests checking
System → user: returns omissions and a completeness report

paragraphs: Arrow direction describes an interaction or dependency, not necessarily a complete timeline. Context describes structural relationships; it is not a flowchart of every action in order.

sections.heading: 5. Applications in three industries
paragraphs: These hypothetical cases help you identify the focal system and its external relationships.

blocks.caption: Table | 5. Applications in three industries
rows: School identity service and grade-management system
PACS and an external inference service, if used
Map service and carrier tracking systems

paragraphs: PACS means Picture Archiving and Communication System: a system for managing medical images.
If an image interpretation platform retrieves CT images from an existing PACS, show:
PACS → AI image interpretation platform: provides the specified patient’s CT images.
If the AI runs locally and calls no external inference service, do not add a cloud LLM API.
Mixing technical options, future plans and the current implemented architecture makes the diagram misleading.

sections.heading: 6. Should an AI Coding Agent appear in the diagram?
paragraphs: Suppose Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode helps write the intake checker, but the finished product calls no AI model when a user operates it.
The Coding Agent is a development-time tool and does not belong among the product’s runtime dependencies.
Conversely, suppose a customer-support platform sends each customer message to an external LLM API to generate an answer.
That model service is a runtime dependency and belongs in the Context diagram.

blocks.caption: Table | 6. Should an AI Coding Agent appear in the diagram?
headers: Include in the product’s runtime Context?
rows: AI generates code and leaves after development
An AI Agent runs tests during development
A support product calls an external LLM API for each answer
The system runs an embedded model locally
Usually describe it as an internal implementation detail at a finer architecture level
The product connects to a separate external AI inference service

paragraphs: Development tools still need security controls. A Coding Agent may read source code, execute commands or access a network, so manage those permissions in the development environment even when it is outside the product’s runtime Context.

sections.heading: 7. Three distinctions that prevent confusion
paragraphs: Use these distinctions when reviewing the scope of your diagram.

blocks.heading: 1. System Context and User Flow answer different questions
paragraphs: User Flow asks which action the user takes first, which follows, and what happens next.
System Context asks which people and external systems have relationships with the system.
For online shopping, “select a product → add it to the cart → check out” is a User Flow. “Shopping system ↔ payment service” describes a relationship for System Context.

blocks.heading: 2. A system boundary is not a security boundary
paragraphs: A box around a medical image analysis platform defines the software scope being discussed.
It does not establish a firewall, TLS encryption, network isolation or access control.
Analyse trust boundaries separately: which trust regions does data cross, and where are validation, authorization, encryption and monitoring needed?

blocks.heading: 3. An external system need not belong to another company
paragraphs: “External” is relative to the focal system.
A company may maintain both its HR and payroll systems, yet payroll can still be an external dependency of the leave-management system.
Decide from responsibility and design scope, rather than machine location or company ownership.

sections.heading: 8. A practical deliverable: architecture.md
paragraphs: Leave a readable record of system scope and relationships. Use this minimum template as a starting point.

blocks.heading: Minimum architecture.md template
paragraphs: Save this template as architecture.md and adapt it to the actual scope; use synthetic data here.
blocks.code:
# System Context — Intake completeness-checking system

## 1. Purpose
Check required fields in synthetic data, identify omissions and export the current report.

## 2. Scope
Focal system: intake completeness-checking system.

## 3. Users
Intake worker: enters data, reviews results and obtains reports.

## 4. External runtime systems
None.

## 5. Relationships
- Intake worker → focal system:
  supplies synthetic data and requests checking and export.
- Focal system → intake worker:
  returns omission feedback and a checking report.

## 6. Outside this scope
- Coding Agent, used only during development.
- Official business acceptance.
- External APIs that have not been implemented.

## 7. Boundary notes
- System scope is not a security trust boundary.
- List unconfirmed integrations separately as open questions.

paragraphs: Ask someone who did not develop the system to read only the diagram and record. They should be able to identify the purpose, users, external dependencies and each relationship’s purpose without mistaking unimplemented functionality for something that exists.

sections.heading: 9. Check your understanding with a scenario
paragraphs: You are developing an AI contract-review system. A lawyer uploads a contract. The system sends the necessary content to an external LLM API, receives an analysis and displays it to the lawyer. Codex helps edit the program during development.
Answer the three questions in the understanding-check section before opening the reference explanations. Reading the explanation does not submit an answer or establish learner understanding.

When you begin designing another system, first establish its responsibilities, users, external dependencies and data exchanges. This record supports later Container, API, authorization and trust-boundary design.

exercise.environment: architecture.md and the synthetic case; paper or a text editor is sufficient.
steps: Draw one focal system and the intake role without Python functions or interface steps.
Draw separate input/feedback relationships with direction, data and purpose. Record actual dependency evidence.
Review each relationship with a peer or yourself, keeping development agents out of invented runtime services and separating current from candidate scope.
exercise.expected: A Context sketch and matching architecture.md node/relationship record.
exercise.check: Readers can identify the focus, role and relationship purposes. No invented services or security claims from the boundary.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic names and public evidence only; include no actual internal system names or architecture.

openChecks.prompt:
Which elements belong in the contract-review product’s runtime Context?
The lawyer, review system, LLM API and Codex, all together
The lawyer, review system and external LLM API
Only the Python program and database
answer: The second option. The lawyer is the user, the review system is the focus and the external LLM API is a runtime dependency. Codex is a development tool whose permissions belong in the development record. Python and database internals belong at finer levels.

openChecks.prompt:
How should “review system → LLM API” be labelled?
Connects
HTTP
Sends contract content for analysis and requests review suggestions
answer: The third option names the data and purpose. “Connects” omits the purpose; HTTP names a transport technology rather than explaining the business relationship.

openChecks.prompt: If the contract contains confidential information, does drawing its transmission in Context mean the data-security problem has been solved? Explain.
answer: No. The diagram identifies data leaving for the model service. Separately establish whether transfer is permitted, which content is necessary, de-identification and retention policies, and validation, authorization, encryption and monitoring. Drawing scope and relationships does not implement or verify security controls.
